summary: MGT Capital Investments filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026 covering two private transactions: Note Exchange Agreement with Project Nickel LLC to extinguish a $1.22M convertible note by issuing 3.25M Series E Preferred shares and 750.13M common shares, and a Securities Purchase Agreement with David M. Garrity for 150M common shares at $0.00033/share ($50,000). These are routine capital-structure adjustments (debt conversion and small equity sale) with no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation catalyst is present. The filing does not represent an M&A event or special situation.
